:::{#def-predicted-probability}
#### Predicted probability

The **predicted probability** of @def-class $k$ at [features](model-validation.qmd#def-feature) $\predvar$ is
the [estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) $\hat{p}_k(\predvar)$ that a [fitted model](model-validation.qmd#def-fitted-model) gives of the [conditional probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-conditional-prob) of that class given those features:

$$\hat{p}_k(\predvar) \eqdef \est{\Prf{\Outvar = k \given \predvar}}$$ {#eq-predicted-probability}

:::
